title: Shadow Physics Laboratory
description: A physics simulation laboratory where the user controls a morphing cube that casts dynamic shadows onto a receiving mesh surface. The user adjusts gravity, morph intensity, light angle, bounce damping, and simulation speed to guide the animated cube through a shadow-matching calibration sequence on the ground plane.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a Shadow Physics Laboratory simulation. Load ShadowmappableMesh.glb as the ground receiver surface positioned at y=0 and AnimatedMorphCube.glb floating above it at y=3. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at position (5, 6, 8) looking at the origin with OrbitControls for free navigation. Add a DirectionalLight with shadow mapping enabled (2048x2048 shadow map, shadow camera frustum covering -5 to 5 on all axes) positioned initially at (3, 8, 3). Enable shadows on the renderer and configure the ShadowmappableMesh to receive shadows and the AnimatedMorphCube to cast shadows. Create an AnimationMixer for the morph cube and play its morph animation. Implement a GUI panel (using lil-gui from CDN) with these interactive controls: (1) Gravity slider (0.1 to 2.0, default 0.8) controlling how fast the cube falls toward the surface. (2) Morph Speed slider (0.1 to 3.0, default 1.0) scaling the morph animation timeScale. (3) Light Azimuth slider (0 to 360 degrees) rotating the directional light around the Y axis at fixed elevation. (4) Light Elevation slider (2 to 12) adjusting the light height. (5) Bounce Damping slider (0.1 to 0.95, default 0.6) controlling energy retention when the cube hits the ground surface. (6) A Reset button that returns the cube to y=3 and resets velocity. Implement simple physics: each frame apply gravity to the cube velocity, update its Y position, and when it contacts y=0.5 (approximate surface), reverse velocity multiplied by damping to create a bouncing effect. The morph animation should continue playing during bouncing. The shadow cast by the morphing cube onto the ShadowmappableMesh should visibly change shape as the cube morphs and moves. Display a small HUD showing current cube height, velocity, and bounce count. Validate that all six parameters produce visible changes in the simulation behavior. Use requestAnimationFrame with a clock delta for smooth updates.
